text:
The dish looks like a flatbread or toast with an avocado or pesto spread, topped with arugula, radish, carrot and pistachios. It is cut into two pieces on a plate about 20 cm across. The two pieces together measure roughly 17 cm by 8 cm, which is about the size of one small flatbread. I estimate the weight at about 130 g and the energy at about 300 kcal.
